actual_executed_work.inherited_reference_training: V80 SHORT_REF and TERMINAL_REF acquisition/fitting are charged in each method's inherited cost fields, not sampled again or added to new V81 transitions.

evidence_scope: Completeness describes execution and pairing, not policy improvement. Within-lifecycle paired means precede averaging across three independent lifecycles; these results do not establish significance. Query trajectory differences are response, not optimality. V80 references differ in architecture and experience as well as labels. Their inherited training cost is separate from new V81 sampling. Shared method cost attributions must not be summed as actual execution cost. A terminal advantage under the parent policy does not guarantee the return of the revised policy that changes later actions.
